recommendation: Keep the commit. It is a bounded cleanup of active source that still reflected the old List/section.content model while preserving List as supporting data unless its narrative is incorporated into Composition text.
issue_request: FHIR-7404 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked whether FHIR document narrative had the same flexibility as CDA and resolved to move narrative into Composition and inline relevant List content into Composition sections.
initial_application: Git-svn commits 686889f8a3b83c74a4e58ddddfac7616dd0da4ca and 749c4dd88234688f57191d3d0b4d62bdc525b87d refactored Composition from section.content/List toward section.text and section.entry and updated the Documents guide presentation list.
additional_context: Older DSTU1 issues such as FHIR-5152 and FHIR-5154 added List.text-as-attested-content language for the old model. FHIR-7404 superseded that model, and FHIR-15723 later clarified that additional resources outside the document presentation are not attested content.
reconciliation: Updated Composition notes, Composition.section.title comments, and List narrative notes to remove section.content/List.text attested-content guidance and point document narrative to Composition narrative or Composition.section.text.
